chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him (peace be upon him) about semen that hits the garment. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Wash the entire garment if its location is hidden from you, whether it was a little or a lot.'

key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: Semen, the fluid emitted during sexual arousal or climax, which is considered najasah (ritually impure) in Shia jurisprudence.
key_terms.خَفِيَ: Hidden or obscured, referring to the inability to locate the specific spot of impurity.
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: All of it / the entirety, indicating the scope of the washing required.
key_terms.يُصِيبُ: Hits or stains, referring to the contact of the impure substance with the object.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on washing clothes when the exact location of a semen stain is unknown?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from the companion Sama'ah addresses the practical jurisprudence of *taharat al-thawb* (purification of garments) when the precise location of semen (*mani*) is obscured. It establishes the principle of washing the entire garment if the stain's extent is unknown, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on certainty in ritual purity for prayer. This ruling underscores the distinction between the physical substance of semen and its effect on ritual state, a key topic in *Fiqh al-Sadiq*.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,
‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the semen hitting the clothes. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Wash the clothes, all of it, when its place is hidden upon you, whether it was a little or a lot’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of semen that pollutes one’s clothes.
He (the Imam) said, ‘You must wash all of your clothes when you do not know exactly the polluted spot, regardless, if it is a little or large area.’”
